segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on your account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so it’s Northlake Dental Group, and my email is jared.mills@northlakedental.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have your account pulled up. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add three more seats for the front desk team before Monday. We’re at 42 right now and need to get to 45.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can take care of that. I’m seeing you’re on the annual Standard plan at $38 per seat per month, billed through March 31, 2026. Adding three seats today will prorate to $1,026.00 for the remaining term. Does that sound okay?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches what finance approved. Can you also send the receipt to ap@northlakedental.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I’m adding the seats in the billing tool now, and I’ll add that AP address for the receipt. Okay, the account now shows 45 seats available.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Do I need to do anything else to assign them?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Just go into the admin console, Users, then Invite users. You’ll see three available seats. The receipt should hit ap@northlakedental.com in the next few minutes, and I’ve noted this under ticket 482917.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, that’s all I needed. Thanks.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Have a good one.
